description: Climate Forced Hydropower Simulations for the African Continent Using NASA NEX GDDP is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ana Lucía Cáceres, Paulina Jaramillo (Carnegie Mellon University). This dataset includes the results of simulations of future hydropower usable capacity for power plants across the five African power pools. These include 87 power plants in 27 different countries. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
